equity.level_reason: Coverage by county SVI tertile is reported and interpreted (highest in least vulnerable counties, attributed to cost and billing barriers), but values are only set side by side with CI-overlap significance and no computed difference or ratio, so v4 caps it at 2.

level_alternative.reason: SVI is an area index used as a stratifier, so if the side-by-side tertile values count as quantified contrasts, level 3 is met without the word disparity, and cost/billing barriers and limited resources are named as explanations.
